test_cases.prompt: Wait, what? I don't understand that last message.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes wait-what skill to re-pitch the last message with more context, simpler language, and domain vocabulary.
test_cases.notes: Explicit confusion is a key trigger.

test_cases.prompt: You're using jargon I don't know. Explain that again.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes wait-what skill to re-pitch using ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English.
test_cases.notes: Jargon correction is a valid trigger.

test_cases.prompt: You assumed I knew that. Give me more context.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes wait-what skill to re-pitch with the missing context supplied.
test_cases.notes: Context gap is a valid trigger.

test_cases.prompt: Help me decide on the architecture for this module.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes grill-me or grill-with-docs skill instead. Wait-what re-pitches the last message; grill interviews about a topic.
test_cases.notes: grill-me is the sibling skill for topic discussion.

test_cases.prompt: Update the project's glossary with new terms.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes domain-modeling skill instead. Domain-modeling updates CONTEXT.md; wait-what uses existing CONTEXT.md.
test_cases.notes: domain-modeling is the sibling skill for vocabulary maintenance.

test_cases.prompt: Design a shared language for the team.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes grill-with-docs skill instead. Grill-with-docs builds shared language upfront; wait-what fixes miscommunication after the fact.
test_cases.notes: grill-with-docs is the sibling skill for building shared language.

test_cases.notes: Simplification request is a valid trigger.
